title: Business Analysist, Business Intelligence
description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 09/25/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 2\+ Years
* Salary 50 K \~ 60 K
* City Ahmedabad
* State/Province Gujarat
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 380015
### **Job Description**


**Job Description – Business Analyst (BI \& AI)**

 **1\. About the Role**

  

We are looking for a **Business Analyst – BI \& AI** who can bridge the gap between business requirements, product teams, technology teams, and data\-driven decision\-making.

  

The candidate should have strong analytical and documentation skills, with hands\-on exposure to **BI, AI, data visualization, and productivity tools**. The role will involve understanding business requirements, converting them into structured product requirements, preparing BRDs/FRDs/User Stories, analyzing business data, and coordinating with cross\-functional teams for successful implementation.

  

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across **Product, Development, QA, UI/UX, Support, Sales, and Business teams**.

 **2\. Key Responsibilities**

 **Business Analysis \& Requirement Management**

  

* Understand business processes, user needs, and product requirements.
* Gather, analyze, and document functional and business requirements.
* Prepare and maintain:
* + Business Requirement Documents (BRD)
	+ Functional Requirement Documents (FRD)
	+ User Stories
	+ Acceptance Criteria
	+ Process Flows / Workflows
	+ Use Cases
	+ Functional Specifications
* Identify gaps, dependencies, assumptions, and potential edge cases in requirements.
* Convert business requirements into clear and implementation\-ready specifications.
* Participate in requirement discussions with internal and external stakeholders.

 **BI \& Data Analysis**

  

* Work with business data to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and insights.
* Prepare dashboards, reports, and analytical views using BI tools.
* Understand data sources, data relationships, KPIs, and business metrics.
* Work with various databases to extract and validate data.
* Support creation of business dashboards and management reports.
* Analyze existing reports and recommend improvements based on business requirements.
* Validate data accuracy between source systems, reports, and dashboards.

 **AI \& Productivity Tools**

  

* Explore and utilize **AI tools** to improve requirement analysis, documentation, data analysis, reporting, and productivity.
* Use AI\-assisted tools for:
* + Requirement analysis
	+ User Story creation
	+ Documentation
	+ Data analysis
	+ Report/dashboard ideation
	+ Process optimization
* Stay updated with emerging **AI, BI, analytics, and automation tools**.
* Identify practical opportunities where AI can improve business processes and product capabilities.

 **Cross\-Functional Coordination**

  

* Coordinate effectively with Product, Development, QA, UI/UX, Sales, Support, and other departments.
* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Clarify requirements and resolve functional ambiguities during development and testing.
* Participate in sprint planning, requirement walkthroughs, UAT, and product demonstrations.
* Track requirement changes and communicate their impact to relevant stakeholders.

 **Product \& Process Analysis**

  

* Study existing product workflows and identify improvement opportunities.
* Analyze business processes and suggest process optimization.
* Identify functional gaps and translate them into product enhancement requirements.
* Support product teams in defining new features and improving existing functionality.
* Ensure requirements are aligned with business objectives and end\-user expectations.

 **3\. Required Skills**

 **Must Have**

  

* 1\+ year of experience as a **Business Analyst / Product Analyst / Functional Analyst / BI Analyst**.
* Strong understanding of business analysis concepts and requirement gathering.
* Good knowledge of **BRD, FRD, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and process documentation**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of data and business reporting.
* Hands\-on exposure to at least one BI / visualization tool such as:
* + Power BI
	+ Tableau
	+ Similar BI platforms
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of **Databases**.
* Good understanding of databases and data structures.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Good proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams.

 **Preferred**

  

* Exposure to **AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Lovable, or similar tools**.
* Experience using AI for business analysis, documentation, data analysis, or productivity.
* Knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
* Good understanding of REST APIs and JSON.
* Understanding of Agile / Scrum methodology.
* Experience working with Gitlab or similar project management tools.
* Experience in enterprise software/product development.
* Basic understanding of UI/UX and application workflows.

 **4\. Key Competencies**

  

* Business \& Functional Analysis
* Analytical Thinking
* Data Interpretation
* BI \& Dashboard Development
* AI Tool Adoption
* Requirement Documentation
* Problem Solving
* Process Understanding
* Stakeholder Management
* Cross\-Functional Coordination
* Communication Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Product Thinking

 **5\. Educational Qualification**

  

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field**.
* Additional certification in **Business Analysis, BI, Data Analytics, or AI** will be an advantage.

 **6\. What We Expect From the Candidate**

  

The candidate should be able to independently take a requirement from:

 **Business Requirement Requirement Analysis BRD/FRD User Stories Development Clarification QA/UAT Support Business Validation**

  

At the same time, the candidate should be able to work with business data and BI tools to:

 **Data Analysis Insight Dashboard/Report Business Decision**

  

The ideal candidate is therefore not only a documentation\-focused BA, but someone who can **understand the business, analyze data, leverage AI tools, and work closely with technology teams to deliver practical product solutions.**

 **7\. Experience**

 **Preferred:** 1–3 years

  

Candidates with strong analytical skills, good BI/AI tool exposure, and excellent requirement/documentation capabilities may be considered even if their experience is slightly below the preferred range.

title: Sr. Data Analyst
description:
### **Job Description**


**Job Title:** Sr. Data Analyst


**Experience:** 5 to 8 Years


**Location:** Ahmedabad/Remote


**Job Type:** Full Time


**Department:** Data Engineering


**About Simform:**


Simform is a premier digital engineering company specializing in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform is a strong partner for Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 5\+ countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market.


Simform takes pride in being one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work\-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.  

  



**Role Overview** We are looking for a seasoned Senior BI Analyst to join our growing Data Analytics team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain end\-to\-end business intelligence solutions for diverse client projects. You will work closely with data engineers, solution architects, and business stakeholders to transform raw data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate is technically strong, comfortable working in US/UK shift hours, passionate about mentoring peers, and capable of managing responsibilities across multiple concurrent projects.  

  



**Key Responsibilities**


**BI Development \& Reporting**


* Design, develop, and publish interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI (mandatory) and other BI/reporting tools.
* Build and optimize data models (star/snowflake schema) to support complex analytical use cases.
* Write advanced DAX measures, calculated columns, and KPIs aligned to business requirements.
* Integrate reports with multiple data sources including relational databases, data warehouses, APIs, and flat files.
* Ensure report performance through query optimization, incremental refresh, and aggregation strategies.
* **Data Engineering \& Pipeline Exposure**


Work hands\-on within end\-to\-end data Engineering project lifecycle — ingestion, transformation, modelling, and visualization.


Collaborate with data engineers on pipeline design using tools such as Azure Data Factory, dbt, Databricks, or equivalent.


Write complex SQL queries for data extraction, profiling, cleansing, and validation across large datasets.


Understand and contribute to data warehouse/lake architecture decisions as a BI stakeholder.


**Engineering Strategy \& Measurement Frameworks**
* Lead client discussions to define KPIs, measurement frameworks, event structures, and success metrics aligned with business objectives.
* Design event\-driven measurement models, tagging architectures, and data\-layer specifications.
* Drive strategy for user behavior tracking, conversion optimization, funnel measurement, cohort analysis, and customer journey Engineering.


**Privacy\-Conscious \& Healthcare\-Friendly Engineering**
* Implement HIPAA\-compliant and privacy\-aware Engineering solutions.
* Work with consent management platforms like OneTrust, Cookiebot, Termly, Freshpaint, Piwik PRO to ensure compliant tracking and data governance.
* Support server\-side tagging implementations and secure data collection practices.
  

**Technical Troubleshooting \& Data Integrity**


Troubleshoot data discrepancies, broken pipelines, tagging issues, and tracking inconsistencies across web/app ecosystems.


Validate data between GTM/Tealium/Piwik PRO, Engineering platforms (GA4, Adobe, Amplitude), CRM systems, and BI reporting layers.


**Stakeholder \& Client Engagement**


Gather and translate business requirements into scalable BI solutions for client projects.


Present dashboards and insights to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


Manage expectations and communicate delivery timelines effectively across multiple simultaneous projects.


Provide user training, best practices, and business intelligence support to stakeholders.


Work in US/UK shift alignments to collaborate with global client teams and ensure timely delivery.
* **Mentoring \& Knowledge Sharing**


Actively mentor and upskill junior and mid\-level BI analysts within the team.


Review dashboards and data models developed by juniors, providing structured feedback.


Contribute to internal knowledge repositories, best practices documentation, and BI standards.


Participate in team skill\-building initiatives, demos, and internal training sessions.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**


**Primary BI Skills (Must\-Have)**


* **Advanced Power BI — Required**
* Expert\-level DAX, Power Query (M), row\-level security, composite models
* Experience with Power BI Service — workspaces, deployment pipelines, gateways
* Dataflows, paginated reports (Power BI Report Builder) are a plus
* Proficiency in at least one additional BI/reporting tool, such as:
* Tableau, Looker, SSRS, MicroStrategy, Qlik Sense, or Amazon QuickSight
* Knowledge of Engineering platforms (GA4, Adobe, Amplitude) and tag management tools (GTM, Tealium, Piwik PRO).
* Understanding of event\-driven Engineering, data layers, and measurement frameworks.
  

  

Awareness of HIPAA/privacy\-compliant Engineering and consent management tools (OneTrust, Cookiebot, etc.).

**Data \& Engineering Skills (Mandatory)**


* Strong SQL — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures, query performance tuning
* Strong data modelling — dimensional modelling, fact/dimension tables, schema design
* Working knowledge of data pipeline tools (ADF, dbt, Spark, Databricks, or equivalent)
* Exposure to cloud platforms — Azure, AWS, or GCP — from a BI/data consumption perspective
* Familiarity with data warehouse technologies such as Snowflake, Azure Synapse, BigQuery, or Redshift

**Certifications (Mandatory, any from below)**


* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\)
* Microsoft Certified: Fabric Engineering Engineer Associate (DP\-600\)
* Any equivalent BI/Engineering certification (Tableau Desktop Specialist, AWS Engineering, Google Cloud Data Analyst, etc.)

**Soft Skills \& Work Preferences**


* Willingness and ability to work in US/UK shift timings on need basis
* Ability to manage and deliver across multiple client projects simultaneously
* Strong communication skills — verbal and written — to interact with global stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to mentor juniors and contribute to team capability building
* Self\-driven with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and continuous learning
* Ability to multi\-task and learn other tools/tech as required
  

  

**Why Join Us:**
* Young Team, Thriving Culture
* Flat\-hierarchical, friendly, engineering\-oriented, and growth\-focused culture.
* Well\-balanced learning and growth opportunities
* Free health insurance.
* Office facilities with a game zone, in\-office kitchen with affordable lunch service, and free snacks.
* Sponsorship for certifications/events and library service.
* Flexible work timing, leaves for life events, WFH and hybrid options

title: Senior Business Analyst - Presales
description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat


**Job Type:** Full Time


**Department:** Pre\-sales BA


**About Simform:**


Simform is a premier digital engineering company specializing in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform is a strong partner for Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 5\+ countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market.


Simform takes pride in being one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work\-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.

  

**Role Overview:**


We are looking for a **Senior Business Analyst (Presales)** to work closely with sales, clients, and internal teams to understand business needs and create effective solution proposals. This role focuses on gathering requirements, preparing client\-facing documents and presentations, supporting presales activities, and helping clients identify the right digital solutions for their business challenges.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**


* Engage with sales leads and account managers to gather, analyze, and document client business and technical requirements for incoming opportunities.
* Conduct independent research on the client's industry, business model, and technology landscape to add contextual depth to proposals.
* Own the end\-to\-end preparation of Proposals, RFP/RFI responses, Statements of Work (SoW), Capability Decks, and Effort Estimation documents in collaboration with the Pre\-Sales Manager and technical leads
* Write and structure proposal content that clearly maps client needs to Simform's service offerings — across **Cloud, Product Engineering, App Development, Custom Software Development, and Digital Engineering** capabilities.
* Ensure all submitted documents are accurate, well\-structured, free of generic content, and reflect measurable value propositions.
* Coordinate review cycles internally, manage document versions, and maintain submission timelines without compromising quality.
* Maintain and continuously improve a library of reusable proposal content, case studies, and capability statements mapped to Simform's verticals and service lines.
* Participate in discovery calls and requirement workshops with prospects, asking the right questions to surface unstated needs and project risks.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**


* **3–5 years of experience in Business Analysis**, with strong and demonstrable exposure to pre\-sales activities — specifically Proposal Writing, RFP/RFI responses, and SoW preparation.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience in IT services, digital engineering, or product engineering company is strongly preferred.
* Solid understanding of **Cloud, Product Engineering, App Development, Custom Software Development, and Digital Engineering**— sufficient to write accurately about these without needing to be hand\-held by architects.
* Proven ability to gather and convert ambiguous business and technical requirements into structured, solution\-oriented proposal narratives.
* Excellent written communication skills — proposals must demonstrate precision, coherence, and clarity, not just volume.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate across sales, technical, and leadership teams under tight deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**:


* Microsoft Azure certifications (Fundamentals or above) or cloud/BA certifications
* Exposure to key verticals — Fintech, Healthcare, Retail \& E\-Commerce, or Supply Chain.
* Familiarity with agile delivery models and co\-engineering engagement structures.
* Experience using proposal tools, content libraries, or CRM\-integrated pre\-sales workflows.

**Why Join Us:**


* Young Team, Thriving Culture
* Flat\-hierarchical, friendly, engineering\-oriented, and growth\-focused culture.
* Well\-balanced learning and growth opportunities
* Free health insurance.
* Office facilities with a game zone, in\-office kitchen with affordable lunch service, and free snacks.
* Sponsorship for certifications/events and library service.
* Flexible work timing, leaves for life events, WFH and hybrid options

title: Analyst II, Global Procurement Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

**About the position**As a Buyer – Capital procurement, you will support all strategic planning and sourcing activities for Capital Procurement, including, but not limited to Equipment, Engineering, Construction Services and Design Build with a total category spend of \+$600MM across the Kraft Heinz North American Zone (U.S. and Canada). You will leverage your experience and knowledge to build comprehensive strategies at the category level and execute the strategy through the sourcing process. You will champion program compliance through Supplier and Contract Management, creating value for Kraft Heinz. You will partner closely with various business units, operations, engineering, finance, and other corporate function stakeholders to provide innovative new products and services to meet business objectives. The successful candidate must be able to focus on balancing superior service to internal business clients, collaborating with a global view while maximizing value for the company of materials and services purchased.
**Essential Functions \& Responsibilities*** Manage mid\-level clients and supplier relationships continuously to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Develop Sourcing and Category Management for assigned portfolios of critical categories to Kraft Heinz.
* Research and support in the development of the supplier base for specific categories.
* Be a part of discussions with suppliers around long\-term objectives and strategies, ongoing market trends, innovation and technology advances, and potential investment decisions.
* Support major supplier issues and work with stakeholders to identify and drive resolution.
* Identify business needs at the sourcing and category project level in the following areas: Assurance of Supply, Quality, Service, Cost, and Innovation (AQSCI).
* Build strong business relationships to increase influence over total category spend.
* Identify and evaluate potential value\-generating projects based on complexity, resources, risk, implementation time, and estimated financial impact.
* Manage assigned portfolio of projects for the category in the near and long\-term.
* Support the supplier selection and RFx award process.
* Executes complex contracts in accordance with policies and processes; ability to apply competency across assigned categories.
* Applies advanced levels of negotiation techniques and tools in all situations; ability to apply competency across assigned categories.
* Develop Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) at the category level through collaboration with Data Analytics, accountable for measuring and reporting value delivery.
* Enable continuous process improvement and cost reduction.
* Ensure the strategic sourcing process is robustly applied to all sourcing projects.
* Collaborates with global procurement peers as needed to ensure support of and alignment to the supported functions.

**Expected Experience \& Required Skills*** Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical / Civil / Electrical), supply chain management.
* 7\+ years of proven experience in Indirect Procurement or combination of design, construction, or food equipment industry experience.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to analyze complex data and make informed decisions.
* Fluency in English.
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) and have an understanding for source\-to\-pay tools (SAP, Ariba, etc.).

**Location(s)**
---------------

  

  

Ahmedabad \- Venus Stratum GCC  

  

  

**Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes.**
